reconstructions.claim: The two-valuedness Dirac's equation makes necessary is precisely the degree of freedom Pauli had posited as a bare postulate; Dirac's formalism must reproduce it to count as a success.
reconstructions.component: The spin degree of freedom that Dirac's problem describes as inserted by hand. It is Pauli's fourth two-valued quantum number, and Dirac's four-component spinor recovers exactly it.
alternatives: Uhlenbeck and Goudsmit's spinning-electron picture (Oct 1925) supplied the physical interpretation; Pauli supplied the formal degree of freedom.
reconstructions.trace: spin has to be inserted by hand
refuters: Evidence that Dirac's equation was developed without reference to the two-valued number.
A demonstration that the relativistic equation forces spin independently of any prior two-valued constraint.
reconstructions.note: A constraint the later work must satisfy, not material it is built from. Real dependency, different flavour from R01.

reconstructions.claim: No argument available. Hilbert-space axiomatisation is not a resource R1's reasoning-from-RL result draws on.
reconstructions.component: None nameable. R1's outcome-reward RL loop and its emergent chains of thought are unchanged if von Neumann's axiomatisation is deleted from history.
alternatives: n/a
reconstructions.trace: No trace.

reconstructions.claim: Every Transformer sub-layer is wrapped in a residual connection. The architecture as published does not train without it.
reconstructions.component: The residual connection around each of the two sub-layers, plus the layer normalisation applied to that sum. Remove the skip and gradient flow through a deep stack of attention blocks degrades exactly as ResNet's problem statement describes.
alternatives: Highway networks (Srivastava et al. 2015) were the available gated alternative; the Transformer uses the ungated identity form specifically.
reconstructions.trace: we employ a residual connection around each of the two sub-layers, followed by layer normalization
refuters: Evidence that the published Transformer trains to the reported BLEU without residual connections.
A reading of section 3.1 that does not cite He et al.
reconstructions.trace_locator: Vaswani et al., 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017), section 3.1, citing He et al. 2016
reconstructions.note: THE case for this evidence class. Our corpus is completely silent - the fixture's Transformer entry lists self-attention, positional encodings and multiple heads and never mentions the residual stream - so no method reading our text can reach it. The argument reaches it, and the trace is external and citable.

reconstructions.claim: ResNet is AlexNet's recipe - deep convolutional stack, ReLU, ImageNet at scale - with skip connections added to remove the depth ceiling that recipe hit.
reconstructions.component: The stack being deepened. ResNet's degradation problem only exists for a network of the AlexNet type trained on the AlexNet benchmark; the residual block is a modification to an inherited object, not a new one.
alternatives: None in vision at that date. The alternative was to abandon depth.
reconstructions.trace: Adding layers past roughly twenty makes networks worse on training error as well as test error
refuters: Evidence the degradation result was obtained on a non-convolutional architecture.
A pre-2012 statement of the same depth ceiling.
reconstructions.note: The corpus never names AlexNet here, but the object being modified is unambiguous from the problem statement.

reconstructions.claim: Tempting because both are 'geometry from an equation', but AlphaFold 2 does not solve a Schrodinger eigenvalue problem. The resemblance is at the level of description, not apparatus.
reconstructions.component: None nameable. The Evoformer, the pair representation and the structure module contain no wave equation and no eigenvalue solve; AF2 predicts coordinates from evolutionary covariation, not from quantum energetics.
alternatives: Molecular-mechanics force fields and Rosetta-style statistical potentials were the physics-flavoured alternatives, and AF2 beat them by not being one.
reconstructions.trace: No trace.
refuters: A component of AF2 that solves or approximates a Schrodinger equation.
Evidence the structure module's loss is derived from quantum energetics rather than geometry.

reconstructions.claim: AlphaGo's policy and value networks are deep convolutional networks trained at scale on GPUs - the artifact AlexNet established as trainable and effective.
reconstructions.component: The evaluation function itself. AlphaGo's own problem statement says no hand-written evaluation had reached professional strength; what replaces it is a deep convnet, which is AlexNet's contribution.
alternatives: Hand-crafted evaluation, explicitly ruled out in the entry's own problem statement; shallow learned evaluators, which had also failed.
reconstructions.trace: Policy and value networks trained on human games and then on self-play
refuters: Evidence AlphaGo's networks were not convolutional or not deep.
A contemporaneous non-deep evaluator of comparable strength.

reconstructions.claim: Both restrict attention to measurable quantities, but that is a methodological mood, not a resource. The scaling-law fits inherit no operator algebra.
reconstructions.component: None nameable. The power-law fits in parameters, data and compute are ordinary empirical regression; deleting matrix mechanics changes none of them.
alternatives: Positivist 'observables only' framings were available from Mach onwards and from ordinary empirical practice; nothing here is specific to Heisenberg.

refuters: A citation showing the scaling-laws method was derived from matrix mechanics rather than from curve fitting.

reconstructions.claim: The Compton shift is proportional to h. Planck's constant is not context here - it is a term in the predicted formula.
reconstructions.component: The magnitude of the predicted wavelength shift, h/(m_e c) times (1 - cos theta). Remove h and the collision calculation predicts no specific shift and cannot be compared with the measurement.
alternatives: None. No other quantum of action was available, and the photon energy and momentum are both denominated in h.
reconstructions.trace: predict the scattered wavelength as a function of angle
refuters: A derivation of the Compton shift that does not contain h.
Evidence Compton fitted the shift empirically rather than predicting it.
reconstructions.note: ANSWER-KEY GAP, NOT A FALSE POSITIVE. Planck -> Compton is a real, required dependency that dependencies.json did not contain; the key held Einstein -> Compton (the light-quantum ontology) and missed Planck -> Compton (the constant in the formula). Drawn as a random control BECAUSE the key was incomplete. The row was added to dependencies.json on 2026-09-07 and the criteria numbers regenerated.

reconstructions.claim: Heisenberg's arrays are indexed by pairs of Bohr stationary states and their entries are transition amplitudes between them. Bohr's ontology is what the index set ranges over.
reconstructions.component: The index structure of the array. Delete stationary states and transitions and there is nothing for the rows and columns to be, and no spectral intensities to reproduce.
alternatives: None. The observable-quantities programme was defined against the Bohr-Sommerfeld orbits specifically.
reconstructions.trace: represent each transition by an array indexed by pairs of states
refuters: Evidence the arrays were indexed by something other than stationary states.
A formulation of the 1925 paper that does not presuppose discrete transitions.
reconstructions.note: The corpus never names Bohr in Heisenberg's entry - it says 'the old quantum theory' - so no naming or vocabulary method can reach this. The argument reaches it, and anchors on a verbatim phrase.

reconstructions.claim: Bohr's quantisation of angular momentum and his derived Rydberg constant are both denominated in Planck's constant h.
reconstructions.component: The numerical value of the Rydberg constant, and the unit in which angular momentum is quantised. Remove h and Bohr's model has no quantisation unit and predicts no spectral numbers.
alternatives: No competing quantum of action existed in 1913; the only alternative was a purely empirical Balmer fit with no constant derived from anything.
reconstructions.trace: fixing the Rydberg constant from h, e and the electron mass
refuters: A derivation of the Balmer series that never uses h.
Evidence Bohr took his constant from an empirical fit rather than from Planck.

reconstructions.claim: Dirac's transformation theory is built on the canonical commutation relation qp - pq = i(h/2pi), and his relativistic wave equation carries the same constant. Planck's quantum of action is the unit in which both are denominated.
reconstructions.component: The commutator's scale, and hence the entire quantitative content of the formalism. Set h to zero and the transformation theory degenerates to classical mechanics; there is no operator algebra left, no spin magnetic moment of the predicted size, and no antimatter energy gap of 2mc^2 quantised against anything.
alternatives: None. By 1930 no competing quantum of action existed; every quantum formalism of the period is denominated in h.
reconstructions.trace: Dirac, The Principles of Quantum Mechanics (1930), Ch. IV: the quantum conditions are posed as qp - pq = i(h/2pi), with h Planck's constant.
reconstructions.trace_locator: Dirac, P.A.M., The Principles of Quantum Mechanics, Oxford 1930, Ch. IV (quantum conditions).
refuters: A formulation of Dirac's transformation theory in which h does not appear.
Evidence Dirac took his constant from a source other than Planck's.
reconstructions.note: SAME SHAPE AS THE ANSWER-KEY DEFECT FOUND IN BATCH 2 (Planck -> Compton): the constant is a term in the later formula. Flagged as a probable second key gap, not a fabrication.

reconstructions.claim: The target names the source prominently and still does not depend on it. Matrix mechanics is what wave mechanics is CONTRASTED with, not what it is built from.
reconstructions.component: No component of the wave equation derives from the array algebra. Schrodinger's route was de Broglie's matter waves plus the Hamilton-Jacobi optical-mechanical analogy.
alternatives: de Broglie's matter waves (the actual resource); Hamiltonian optics.
reconstructions.trace: Matrix mechanics works but is opaque, offers no continuous picture of the process, and is hard to apply
refuters: Evidence Schrodinger derived the equation from the array formalism.
A retraction of his published statement that the matrix approach discouraged him.
reconstructions.note: The important refusal. The naming criterion C1 fires here at strength 7.80, third-highest in the corpus, and C1 is otherwise precision 1.00. Reconstruction is what separates a prominent mention from a dependency - which is exactly the question the whole exercise is about.

reconstructions.claim: R1's reinforcement learning on verifiable outcomes, with search behaviour discovered rather than demonstrated, is AlphaGo's self-play-against-a-checkable-result moved from a board to a token stream.
reconstructions.component: The training signal. Both replace human demonstrations with an automatically checkable outcome, and both get search behaviour to emerge from that signal rather than from imitation.
alternatives: The wider RL-from-verifiable-reward literature; AlphaZero more directly than AlphaGo; classical self-play predating both.
reconstructions.trace: letting the model discover its own long chains, self-checking and backtracking from the reward alone
refuters: Evidence R1's RL setup derives from a lineage that does not pass through game self-play.
A demonstration that outcome-verified RL was standard before AlphaGo.
reconstructions.note: Necessity only 'used' and exclusivity 'many' - a family resemblance with a plausible channel, not a required input. Weakest of the reconstructed set.

reconstructions.claim: Von Neumann's spectral theory of self-adjoint operators is the rigorous form of exactly the noncommuting observables matrix mechanics introduced.
reconstructions.component: The operator algebra. Von Neumann's observables are self-adjoint operators that need not commute; without matrix mechanics there is no noncommutation to axiomatise and the spectral theorem is not the tool required.
alternatives: Schrodinger's wave mechanics supplied the other half - the function space - but not the noncommutation.
reconstructions.trace: the spectral theory of self-adjoint operators
refuters: Evidence that the Hilbert-space formulation was arrived at from wave mechanics alone.
A version of the axiomatisation in which observables commute.

reconstructions.claim: The plausible story is false on the dates. AlphaGo's networks as published in 2016 are plain 13-layer convolutional policy and value networks with no residual connections; residual blocks enter this line only with AlphaGo Zero in 2017.
reconstructions.component: No component of the 2016 system fails without residual blocks. The Lee Sedol networks were trained to professional strength without them.
alternatives: Plain deep convolutional stacks at 13 layers, which is what was in fact used and is below the depth at which degradation bites.
reconstructions.trace: No trace in the 2016 system.
refuters: Evidence the Nature 2016 AlphaGo policy or value network used residual connections.
If the target entry were re-scoped to AlphaGo Zero (2017), this becomes required and the verdict flips.
